items.title: No evidence-changing tinnitus research identified in this week's scan
items.whyMatters: Quiet weeks happen. The sources below were checked; nothing met the bar for a meaningful update, and we would rather say so than manufacture a story.
items.summary: Sources checked: PubMed (title/abstract + MeSH), ClinicalTrials.gov (condition + full-text), Watched feeds (FDA press, NIH, journals), FDA databases (510k/PMA/MAUDE — openFDA), News-wire intelligence (labeled, never evidence), Guideline page watcher (AAO-HNSF, NICE).
